user.title: 1/2 · TfL connection
user.description:
Live arrivals come from the official **TfL Unified API**.

An **app key is optional** but recommended: without one TfL only allows a few requests per minute. It is free and takes 2 minutes:
1. Open {url} and **Sign up** (email + password)
2. **Products** → subscribe to **500 Requests per min**
3. **Profile** → copy your **Primary key** and paste it here.

Leave it empty to try the integration first. The key is stored only in your Home Assistant.

start.title: 2/2 · Stops
start.description:
How would you like to add stops?

**Tip:** the easiest way is the **card editor** of the Glowboard cards: results appear **while you type**, with coloured line badges, and one click adds the stop.
